Maya (PM): Quick sync  two pilots ask bulk embeddings in MVP; infra warns of a capacity dip. Need scope decision.
Arun (Eng): Summary of pilot SLAs?
Rahul (CS): Interactive p50 <=225ms and nightly bulk ~7M tokens. They can cover reserved slots if we guarantee perf.
Bea (Infra): We're losing ~20-30% Dedicated GPUs next week for maintenance windows. Autoscale won't cover long nightly runs.
Maya (PM): Options: 1) include bulk in MVP with reserved carve for pilots 2) ship MVP without bulk and add in v1 3) hybrid: public no-bulk, pilot-only carve.
Arun (Eng): Hybrid seems safe: minimal public churn, pilots get features behind org-gate. Implementation: feature flag + routing + fallback to quantized model.
Jin (Design): If hybrid, hide bulk-upload flows for public and surface a "Pilot bulk uploads enabled" badge in org settings.
Bea (Infra): We can carve 2 GPUs nightly 01:00-05:00 UTC for pilots. ~48h to provision + canary. Will add dashboards and alerts.
Rahul (CS): I'll get verbal OK now and push for signed LOI. If LOI misses EOD+2 we auto-disable pilot bulk.
Arun (Eng): Work plan: flag (0.5d), routing + tests (1.5d), canary (0.5d). Fallback route at queue>70%.
Maya (PM): Acceptance for pilot carve: up to 8M tokens/night, interactive p50<=225ms, alert at queue>50%, signed LOI before billing.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feat/pilot-embeds-gate -> staging at 2401230020
Arun (Eng): Will post PR and canary metrics here.
Bea (Infra): I'll provision carve and share dashboards.
Maya (PM): Decision: hybrid pilot carve approved. Action owners: Arun (flag+routing), Bea (provision+dash), Jin (UI), Rahul (contracts). Reopen if legal or capacity changes. :thumbsup:
